title: PATCH: wp_ecx_kmgmt provCtx assignment reordering needs justification comment
description: The devId patch moves ctx->provCtx = provCtx to before wc_InitRng_ex() in wp_ecx_gen_init(). This is required so ctx->provCtx->devId is valid for the RNG init call. But a reader of the patch sees provCtx being assigned before the object is fully initialized, which looks wrong. Add a comment in the patch hunk (and in the applied file): 'provCtx assigned before RNG init so ctx->provCtx->devId is available; safe because ctx allocation already succeeded.'
